paper.title: Universal Representation of Generalized Convex Functions and their Gradients

claims.paper_claim: Finite-support generalized-convex functions are uniformly dense.
production_path: repro/src/c1_proof.py reconstructs the compact finite-cover argument
Z3 checks the local bound and an independent checker evaluates 867 rational assignments
evidence/claims/c1/proof_certificate.json records assumptions and quantifiers
The corrupted-radius negative control produces a countermodel
claims.boundary: Registered compact finite-dimensional assumptions and uniform-norm closure.

claims.paper_claim: Finite-support gradients are dense in gradients of generalized-convex functions.
claims.source_anchor: Gradient-density theorem and supporting topology proposition
production_path: repro/src/c2_audit.py runs source-topology, boundary, corrected-interior, and theorem-level routes
The supporting proposition counterexample is verified
No valid theorem-level counterexample to the existential density claim is found
evidence/claims/c2/raw_run_0f46ec76.json records the unresolved boundary
claims.boundary: Needs a valid gradient topology and clarified theorem scope.

claims.paper_claim: The lean finite parameter set is convex.
production_path: repro/src/c3_search.py performs exact rational/SMT search
The endpoints are lean but their midpoint [0,-1,1/2] loses support
The identity negative control is unsat
evidence/claims/c3/raw_run_b7e56a29.json records the counterexample
claims.boundary: Falsifies the stated compact finite scope; it does not address a narrower unstated definition.

claims.paper_claim: Table I values match exactly through n=10.
production_path: repro/src/c4_table.py compares decimal values and integer thousandths
An independent exact checker finds differences of -0.001 at n=5 and n=10
The tolerance negative control shows that 0.001 tolerance removes the mismatch
evidence/claims/c4/raw_run_3142314a.json records the exact dimensions
claims.boundary: Literal exact-match claim only; the softer phrase virtually identical is not falsified.

claims.paper_claim: The parameterization recovers one- and two-item auction mechanisms.
production_path: repro/src/c5_mechanism.py integrates continuous one- and two-item objectives
Three seeded global searches recover the benchmark prices and revenue
Independent midpoint quadrature checks the two-item revenue
evidence/claims/c5/raw_run_c6b3d274.json records optimizer and control results
claims.boundary: Medium confidence because official Torch training is replaced by a deterministic clean-room optimizer.

claims.paper_claim: Optimal-transport dual potentials are generalized convex and twist inversion recovers the map.
production_path: repro/src/c6_ot.py checks five symbolic dual schemas and 112 exact fraction cases
Nonquadratic twist maps are inverted in dimensions 2, 4, and 8
The non-twist control loses uniqueness as intended
evidence/claims/c6/raw_run_f5de8621.json records errors and controls
claims.boundary: Registered symbolic dual and finite-dimensional twist-map checks.
